description: Rectangular Column Database is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ertugrul Taciroglu, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). This database is provided by extending the one presented by Ghannoum et al. (2015) entitled “NEES: ACI 369 Rectangular Column Database”, which can be found on In this extended version, two new terms including the yield drift ratio and the displacement ductility demand are added to the original database through available technical reports, articles, and ... Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-7qg0-4303. Keywords: Experimental data, rectangular reinforced concrete columns. Published 2019-10-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
